name: blueprint-lld
description: Blueprint — a Low-Level Design practice platform with explainable feedback

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @blueprint/api" "npm run dev -w @blueprint/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @blueprint/web && npm run build -w @blueprint/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @blueprint/shared && npm run test -w @blueprint/api && npm run test -w @blueprint/web
